articles.title: Hackers Use Fake WatchGuard VPN Download Site to Steal Login Credentials
articles.summary:
Hackers used a fake WatchGuard VPN download website to steal login details before offering visitors the real, digitally signed VPN installer. The attack collected a VPN server address, username, and password through a browser pop-up, leaving victims exposed without installing a malicious client. articles.title: FBI Disrupts North Korean Famous Chollima Laptop Farms Used to Infiltrate U.S. Companies

articles.title: VirusTotal Integrates Threat Intelligence With ChatGPT for Malware Analysis
articles.summary:
VirusTotal can now bring threat intelligence into ChatGPT through VirusTotal AI (VTAI), allowing users to investigate suspicious files, URLs, domains, and IP addresses within a conversation. The connection helps analysts retrieve existing reports and explain detection results while keeping the source, analysis date, and coverage visible. articles.title: Google Awarded $250,000 Bounty for a Full-chain Chrome Exploit Found Using GPT-5.6
articles.summary:

The XBOW team says the work took six days and about $40,000 in computing costs, using OpenAI’s publicly available GPT-5.6 Sol model. Google has fixed the flaws. articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Breach Meta GitHub Repositories, Steal Source Code and Data of 1,500 People
articles.summary:
Hackers used an employee’s stolen credentials to access some of Meta’s GitHub repositories, taking product source code and personal information linked to roughly 1,500 people. Most affected individuals are Meta employees in the United States, according to the company’s disclosure to SecurityWeek. Meta confirmed the breach on October 13, 2026, when it began notifying affected […]

articles.title: Attackers Breach European Bank Through Third-Party Gateway and Target WSUS Server
articles.summary:
A European bank was breached through a poorly secured, third-party gateway before an attacker tried to exploit its Windows Server Update Services (WSUS) infrastructure.
